message: 人類の剣

name: Misasagi
message: 「I only saw her the once, mind, but I think she was a female student with short hair.」

name: Shio
message: 「When I stayed late at the Naginata Club, I caught sight of her several times, though only for a fleeting moment, so I could not discern her features clearly. It appeared to be a woman.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I saw her, I saw her~ Thought she was a ghost, I did~ Her face? Ahaha~ What are you expecting from me~? Still, I feel like it was a girl~?」

name: Synn
message: 「So, people who happened to still be at the academy late after dismissal hours have been spotting a female student.」

name: Ria
message: 「Could it be the same girl?」

name: Misa
message: 「We need to strictly enforce that everyone goes home or back to the dorms right at dismissal time. And also--」

name: Synn
message: 「As the Crusaders, we'll have to step up our night patrols too, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「I object.」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」
I think we all looked pretty surprised.
Because it was the very first time Azel had voiced an opinion on Student Council activities, public or secret.

name: Azel
message: 「I am an officer of the Student Council.」

name: Synn
message: 「Object... to the night patrols?」

name: Azel
message: 「There is no need for you people to put yourselves in danger to protect anyone without a single bit of compensation.」

name: Azel
message: 「You are neither the police, nor the military, nor a private security firm. You have no obligation. It is irrational.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We're the only ones who can protect Ryuusei Town, ya know!」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that truly the case?」

name: Ria
message: 「It is. As proof, our Kujou family has fought for generations using the power of the Rosary--」

name: Azel
message: 「For demons to appear exclusively in this one town over such a long span of years is irrational. One should assume they appear all across the world.」
We'd been told from the very beginning that only we could fight, and since I just took that at face value, I'd never even stopped to think about it.
Certainly, there was a chance they appeared outside of here too... or rather, it was unnatural for them to show up only here.

name: Misa
message: 「If they are appearing all over the world, that would mean the same problems as Ryuusei Town are occurring globally...」

name: Azel
message: 「It is rational to conclude that public institutions dedicated to countering demons exist.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A global secret organization... Somehow, that sounds exciting.」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, there's nobody in Ryuusei Town fighting demons besides us.」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio... doesn't count, I suppose.」

name: Azel
message: 「It is more natural to think that demons rarely appear in this town, so the Kujou family could handle them and no personnel from that organization were assigned here.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold on a sec! Then does that mean in other places, way stronger demons are swarming out and fighting humans who oppose them?」

name: Azel
message: 「That would be the case.」

name: Helena
message: 「Unfortunately, that's not how it works.」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Azel-chan. That's quite an interesting theory, but it's a shame. Basically, demons only appear in this town.」

name: Misa
message: 「Isn't that unnatural?」

name: Helena
message: 「Apparently, somewhere in this town, there's a singularity connecting Heaven, the Human World, and the Demon World. This place seems to be a sort of neutral zone.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, couldn't they still travel somewhere else from here?」

name: Helena
message: 「For them, staying in this world for too long isn't good for their health, you see. That's why they don't seem to venture far.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then there isn't any trouble with demons outside of Ryuusei Town?」

name: Helena
message: 「Exactly. So a secret organization like the one Azel-chan mentioned doesn't exist. The only ones who can fight against demons are the Crusaders.」

name: Helena
message: 「Therefore, there is no choice but to have you all handle it, O Crusaders, the swords of humanity!」
We practiced for an hour again today, and then did our Student Council work.
And before we knew it, it was pitch dark. We're out on patrol.

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's dark, isn't it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it is night. Are you going to be okay, Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem. Leave it to your big sister. I'm used to this.」
I see... Ria-senpai and Helena-san--no, the Kujou family--have been patrolling late at night and protecting Ryuusei Town for a long, long time.

name: Nanaka
message: 「O-Over there! There's something there! Kyaa, scary!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, it's not scary enough to cling onto me like that, is it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mgh... Well, not that I'm scared or anything.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hofu.」
Just when I thought Nanaka had pulled away, something soft and wonderful pressed against my other arm!?

name: Ria
message: 「Th-There really is something here!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's fine. I'm sure it's just the rumored female student.」
I feel like I understand how Paqy feels.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mgh... His reaction is totally different from when it was me.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm so jealous of my Ria-chan!」
Ria-senpai quickly pulled away from me.

name: Ria
message: 「I-I wasn't clinging to you or anything. I just lost my footing a little.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, I get it. We have to find out what it really is.」

name: Paqy
message: 「This presence is.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Azel.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, it was just Azel-chan.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, so the rumored female student was.」
We rush over to Azel.

name: Synn
message: 「Good evening.」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you doing?」

name: Ria
message: 「You have to go home before closing time, you know.」

name: Azel
message: 「...I was checking out books.」
As usual, they were all photo books.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa. They're all books with barely any text that look super easy to read! Even I could tear right through these.」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't you ever borrow novels or anything, Azel-chan?」

name: Azel
message: 「Can't read... They're hard to read. Not interested.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's late, so I'll walk you home.」

name: Azel
message: 「No need.」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmh!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's wrong, Synn? Wait, could it be.」

name: Synn
message: 「They're here!」

name: Ria
message: 「Over there!」
In the shadows of the trees lining the path, several dark silhouettes!

name: Cat Demon
message: 「Meow!」
Both sides spotted each other at the exact same moment. Tension shot through the darkness.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Those guys!」
The demons with cat-like ears formed a battle formation and stared fixedly in our direction.

name: Synn
message: 「It doesn't feel like they're going to attack first.」

name: Azel
message: 「Fall back.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We can't fall back here! Because we're the Crusaders, you know.」

name: Ria
message: 「But we have fewer people than last time.」
It's only been two days since we started our special training. And today, there are only three of us.
Since the enemy doesn't seem to be making a move, it looks like we could still retreat.

name: Ria
message: 「Another one's coming. And this one's huge!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are we in trouble?」
Should we have fallen back!?

name: Sally
message: 「Huh, what's everyone doing in the pitch dark?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan!」

name: Sally
message: 「I finished my part-time job so I came to hang out, did I come too late?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, great timing.」
Not many days have passed since we started our special training.
Still, I feel like we're on the verge of grasping something.
To test that out, fighting a battle here won't be a waste.
Besides, we even have Sally-chan's help now.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel. Get away from here quickly.」

name: Azel
message: 「......Illogical.」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe so. Still, we're the Crusaders.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. After all, we're humanity's sword.」

name: Ria
message: 「We won't lose.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go, everyone! To protect the peace of the academy!」
